summary.en: Connect staggered Maxwell fields and time updates.

assumptions: 2D TMz, homogeneous vacuum, ε=μ=c=1, source-free. Lx=1, Ly=1.5; mode (1,1).
units: Dimensionless normalized length, time and fields.
boundary_conditions: Periodic boundaries or Ez=0 on rectangular PEC walls.

next_deliverable.ja: 媒質界面の反射・透過と吸収境界/PMLの反射誤差を別に検証。
next_deliverable.en: Separately validate interface reflection/transmission and absorption/PML reflection error.

limitations.ja: 2次元TMz・一様真空の周期平面波と長方形PEC空洞の教育用実装・固定入力検証です。解析解と独自に導いた離散モード・保存量を参照し、他のFDTDライブラリとの比較は行っていません。PML、反射・透過、散乱体、電荷・電流、分散媒質、3次元一般形状は未実装・未検証です。
limitations.en: Educational fixed-input validation of 2D TMz homogeneous-vacuum periodic waves and a rectangular PEC cavity. References are continuum analytic solutions and separately derived discrete modes/invariants; no independent external FDTD-library comparison is claimed. PML, reflection/transmission, scatterers, charges/currents, dispersive media and general three-dimensional geometries remain unimplemented and unvalidated.

metadata_review.level: Original educational 2D TMz code with continuum/discrete analytic checks, refinement, energy and independent ZIP rerun.
